methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on 2026-06-13 (accessedAt); every figure is a real listed price, with quote-only/contact-sales tiers recorded as null monthlyUsd. Prices are per-seat/per-agent USD billed annually unless a flat per-account or ticket-based model is noted in the plan notes. Two providers (Zendesk, Zoho Desk) geo-redirected to EUR/INR storefronts, so their USD figures are taken from a corroborating price index (last verified Apr 2026) with the vendor pricing page kept as corroboration; minutes/calls/overage-per-minute fields are not applicable to this software category and are null throughout.
